hook_scene: Moscow around 1920: the same blank face cut against soup / a coffin / a woman on a sofa; audiences praise the acting.

working_title: the man who fainted at the frescoes
hook_scene: A French writer walks out of a Florence church unable to steady his heart.
verified_facts: Stendhal described being overwhelmed at Santa Croce in 1817 (Rome, Naples and Florence); psychiatrist Graziella Magherini coined 'Stendhal syndrome' in 1979 and published 106 cases in 1989; it is not a formal DSM-5 diagnosis.
caveats_or_contested: One source dates his entry to 22 January 1817 while 'visiting Naples': confirm the date and place. Stendhal's own text needs checking.
